title: Summary
text: This session had two goals: close out the OpenRouter API migration in StrudelAI through a two-stage subagent review, and diagnose and fix a long-standing AgentWiki limitation where reports from sibling projects were invisible to the compiler. The code quality review identified four Important-severity issues in the streaming layer and model-persistence code: null-body guard before getReader(), try/catch around JSON.parse(argsBuffer), loadModel() validation against FREE_MODELS whitelist, and missing unit tests for loadModel/saveModel. All four were fixed. A branch and PR workflow rule was added to CLAUDE.md after discovering the migration had committed directly to main. The AgentWiki discovery bug was fixed by adding a --scan flag that walks each given directory at depth-0 and depth-1 collecting every reports/ subfolder, deduplicated by resolved path. Node count increased from 5 to 9.

title: Changes
text: strudel-ai/src/lib/ai.ts: Null-body guard before getReader(); try/catch around JSON.parse(argsBuffer). strudel-ai/src/lib/models.ts: loadModel() validates stored value against FREE_MODELS whitelist. strudel-ai/src/lib/models.test.ts: New file with 4 unit tests for loadModel and saveModel. agentwiki/compiler/compiler.py: Added _collect_report_dirs, _extra_reports_dirs; updated compile_inputs and run to accept scan_dirs. agentwiki/compiler/cli.py: Added --scan / -s option to compile, dev, and build commands. agentwiki/tests/test_compiler_scan.py: New file with 11 tests across 3 classes. CLAUDE.md: Added Branch and PR workflow rule.

title: Affected Code
text: streamToolCall<T>() in ai.ts: null body guard and JSON parse error handling. loadModel() in models.ts: validates stored string against FREE_MODELS. saveModel() in models.ts: covered by new unit tests. _collect_report_dirs(reports_dir) in compiler.py: new helper returning sorted subdirs containing report.html. _extra_reports_dirs(scan_dirs) in compiler.py: new helper for depth-0 and depth-1 reports discovery with resolved-path deduplication. compile_inputs(input_dir, scan_dirs) in compiler.py: merges primary and extra report dirs. run(..., scan_dirs) in compiler.py: passes scan_dirs through. compile/dev/build_cmd in cli.py: each gains a repeatable --scan / -s option.

title: Evidence
text: StrudelAI: 39 tests passing after quality fixes including 4 new tests in models.test.ts. AgentWiki test_compiler_scan.py: 11/11 passed in 1.59s. Full AgentWiki suite: 23 passed in 2.03s. uv run agentwiki compile --scan /Users/jimchien/Desktop/Sideproject/claude produces 9 nodes, up from 5 without the --scan flag.

title: Open Questions
text: StrudelAI OpenRouter migration commits landed on main without a PR — retroactive PR not possible; branch/PR rule now in CLAUDE.md for future sessions. --scan is a CLI flag; a future improvement is an agentwiki.toml config file to persist scan directories. AgentWiki Phase 5 (tree-sitter) and Phase 6 (Agent API/MCP) remain unstarted. StrudelAI v0.2 features (multi-voice, mutation, teach mode) and Playwright E2E tests are deferred.
